subject.title: [Bug]: Multiple independent paths cause duplicate Telegram messages

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for an unrooted current Telegram duplicate symptom, or should the fixed Path 1/2/primary-Path-4 history be split away and a new tracker require a current-version reproducer before any delivery-semantics change?
rationale: Current source disproves the proposed Path 3 mechanism, while the surviving reports do not yet identify one executable current-main path; choosing retry, recovery, or fail-closed behavior without that boundary risks message loss.

options.title: Narrow the tracker and require current repro
options.body: Keep the unresolved symptom visible, explicitly mark the prior root cause withdrawn, and require redacted current-version logs plus a minimal reproduction before implementation.

options.title: Close the umbrella after splitting history
options.body: Close this umbrella as fixed/superseded only after a separate issue preserves any reproducible residual Telegram duplicate with current evidence.

recommendation.title: Narrow the tracker and require current repro
recommendation.body: Keep the unresolved symptom visible, explicitly mark the prior root cause withdrawn, and require redacted current-version logs plus a minimal reproduction before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Telegram non-idempotent send contract is central to deciding what explanations are still viable.
